test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: In a 1200 m circular race, A and B start at the same time from the same position in the same direction at speeds of 18 km/h and 27 km/h, respectively. In how much time after the start of race will they meet for the first time on the track?
solution:
**Calculation:**

A and B running in the same direction, their relative speed = (27 - 18) = 9 km/hr = 9 km/hr × 5/18 = 2.5 m/s

They start at the same time, so they meet after 1200/2.5 = 480 seconds

∴ The correct answer is 480 seconds
